text:
**Your coach**

I'm here to help you get where you decide to go — you set the direction, I do the legwork. Before we start, tell me how hands-on you want me.

hint: This is how often I bring things to you between asks — the more I bring, the less you're left figuring out alone.
choices: Very — bring me tasks and ideas on your own

prompt: And should I check in on your progress on my own?
hint: I only chase you as hard as you've asked to be chased — pick the version of me you can live with.
choices: Regularly — hold me to what I took on
